The '''Blue Pinstripe Double Bed''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be obtained as the sixth prize from the prize machine inside [[Mayor's Manor]].

If the [[Blue Pinstripe Bed]] is the only bed in the [[Farmhouse]], or the first bed placed (achieved by removing all other beds before placing it), it is automatically upgraded into a Blue Pinstripe Double Bed when the house is [[Farmhouse#Upgrades|upgraded]] for the first time.

Once obtained for the first time it can be bought again from the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|500}}.
